tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page background behind cards and lists. Never put body text straight on it in long runs; use surface.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, tables, panels, dialogs, inputs. The default home for content.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Sidebar, icon tiles, number keys on options, segmented-control track.

tokens.name: surface-hover
tokens.usage: Hover on rows and list items; table header rows; dialog footers.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Card and panel borders, the sidebar edge, page header rules.

tokens.name: line-soft
tokens.usage: Dividers between rows inside a card. Quieter than line.

tokens.name: line-control
tokens.usage: Borders of secondary buttons, inputs, checkboxes. Below 3:1 on surface (about 1.7:1): every control also carries a label and a hover/focus state, never border alone.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body text, headings, amounts. On surface, ground and surface-sunken in both themes (15:1+).

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Nav labels, secondary text with weight, icon strokes. 10:1 on surface.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Meta lines, captions, column headers, shortcut hints. 5.9:1 on surface, 5.2:1 on surface-sunken (light); 7:1 on surface (dark).

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Non-text only: separators like / in breadcrumbs, disabled icon strokes, placeholder rules. Fails 4.5:1; never for readable text.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Klopt yellow. The K mark, count badges for work waiting, the active match. Text on it is on-brand. Use it in small doses: it means 'here' or 'needs you'.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on brand (12:1).

tokens.name: brand-tint
tokens.usage: Soft yellow ground for suggestions, warnings to act on, the selected option.

tokens.name: brand-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons on brand-tint: 'Suggested', warning callout icons. 4.9:1 light, 8:1 dark.

tokens.name: selection
tokens.usage: Background of the row, to-do or command item the keyboard cursor is on. Always paired with selection-edge.

tokens.name: selection-edge
tokens.usage: 3px inset bar on the left of the selected row, and the 2px border of a suggested option. Decorative: the selection background carries it too.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus outline, 2px with a 2px offset. Ink in light (yellow is too pale on white), yellow in dark.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Fill of the one primary button per view (New invoice, Send). Black, not yellow.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Label on primary.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Paid, matched, mapped, sealed. Text on success-bg or surface.

tokens.name: success-bg
tokens.usage: Paid pill ground.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Overdue, late, failed. Always with a word ('76 days late'), never colour alone.

tokens.name: danger-bg
tokens.usage: Overdue pill and overdue count badge ground.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Open (sent, not due yet), to approve. Text on info-bg.

tokens.name: info-bg
tokens.usage: Open pill ground, approval icon tile.

tokens.name: neutral-bg
tokens.usage: Draft pill, neutral count badge, quiet icon tiles. Text on it: ink-2.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Charts only: the 61–90 days ageing band next to danger. Not for text.

tokens.name: chart-1
tokens.usage: Primary series in bars (income).

tokens.name: chart-2
tokens.usage: Comparison series (expenses), track fills.

tokens.name: backdrop
tokens.usage: Behind the command bar, dialogs and the shortcut sheet.

styles.name: amount-xl
styles.usage: The one amount a detail view is about. Tabular numerals.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Final notices are ready for Molenaar Media.
styles.usage: Default UI text, table cells, form values.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Meta lines, captions, hint bars. Colour ink-muted.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Table column headers and small section labels, uppercase. ink-muted.

styles.name: kbd
styles.usage: Keyboard keys only. Never for numbers in tables: those use the sans with tabular figures.

spacing.note: 4px base. Pages pad 32px sideways (40 on Home), cards 20–24px, rows 12–20px.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Between keys in a chord, icon to count.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside buttons (icon to label), between pills and buttons in a toolbar.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap in page headers, between list tabs and the list.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Grid gap of stat tiles, input groups, row padding sideways in dense lists.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding, row padding sideways in tables.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between page sections and cards side by side.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Page side padding.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Home page side padding, empty-state padding.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Kbd keys, checkboxes.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Number keys on options.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, nav items, segmented tabs.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Choice options, icon tiles.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, tables.

tokens.name: radius-2xl
tokens.usage: Command bar and dialogs.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Status pills, count badges, avatars, switches.

tokens.name: shadow-raised
tokens.usage: Active nav item and segmented tab: lifted one step off the sidebar.

tokens.name: shadow-paper
tokens.usage: The invoice preview sheet. Only things that are paper get it.

tokens.name: shadow-overlay
tokens.usage: Command bar, dialogs, shortcut sheet.

tokens.name: control-h
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, search field.

tokens.name: control-h-sm
tokens.usage: Small buttons inside rows and toolbars, list tabs.

tokens.name: row-h
tokens.usage: Table and list rows: minimum height.

tokens.name: nav-h
tokens.usage: Sidebar items.

tokens.name: sidebar-w
tokens.usage: Sidebar width; stacks above content on phones.
